channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-124499 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0 | A vulnerability was identified in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This affects the function write_translations of the file application/controllers/ToolController.class.php of the component Translation Tool. The manipulation of the argument lang leads to code injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-124500 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A security flaw has been discovered in Fengoffice Feng Office up to 3.11.13.11/4.2.1.2. This impacts the function upload_document_image of the file application/controllers/FilesController.class.php of the component File Handler. The manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-124501 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A weakness has been identified in Tidelift moto up to 5.2.4. Affected is an unknown function of the file moto/batch/models.py of the component AWS Batch Emulation. This manipulation of the argument privileged/volumes causes improper privilege management. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-124502 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A security vulnerability has been detected in yungifez Skuul School Management System up to 2.6.3. Affected by this vulnerability is the function GraduationController::resetGraduation of the file app/Http/Controllers/GraduationController.php of the component Delete Handler. Such manipulation of the argument student leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.0.0 addresses this issue. The name of the patch is b42f2c80a8e5e01ca6e607bbd97f137ede368ac9. The affected component should be upgraded.

item.title: CVE-2026-124504 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was detected in erupts erupt up to 2.3.0. Affected by this issue is the function ReportService.queryBiData of the file ReportService.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument sort results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.4.0 can resolve this issue. The patch is named 8d2eaffc79b977c9d11222b9d435a002dceaa062. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

item.title: CVE-2026-124507 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was found in conductor-oss conductor up to 3.32.4/3.33.0/3.34.0-rc3/4.0.0-alpha.1. item.title: CVE-2026-124508 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was determined in floci-io Floci up to 2.4.0. Impacted is the function BuildspecParser.parseArtifacts of the file src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/codebuild/CodeBuildJsonHandler.java of the component Artifact Handler. This manipulation of the argument buildspecOverride.artifacts.base-directory causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-124509 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was identified in floci-io Floci up to 2.1.0. The affected element is the function S3Destination.bucketName of the file services/firehose/model/DeliveryStreamDescription.java of the component S3 Destination Configuration Handler. Such manipulation of the argument BucketARN leads to path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.2.0 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is b986b95074ef524019be7af51e1df172e48faa4b. You should upgrade the affected component.
